metas.name: #Home
metas.description: Oliver Twist (Indrans) wants to be tech-savvy and become a better companion to his two sons, who spend more time on their phones than with their loved ones.

metas.name: Maremma
metas.description: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

metas.name: Pariyerum Perumal
metas.description: A law student from a lower caste begins a friendship with his classmate, a girl who belongs to a higher caste, and the men in her family start giving him trouble over this.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: Django Unchained
metas.description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.

metas.name: Video
metas.description: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Thani Oruvan
metas.description: Siddharth Abimanyu, an influential scientist, is involved in various illegal medical practices. Mithran, an efficient IPS officer, decides to expose him.

metas.name: Soodhu Kavvum
metas.description: Das, with his team, kidnap Arumai, son of a politician, who has been planning his own kidnapping to extract money from his father. Problems arise, when an insane cop is brought to handle the case.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: The Crow's Egg
metas.description: Two slum kids yearn to taste a pizza after being enticed by the pizza shop that has opened near their locality. What happens when they manage to find the money to buy one?

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

metas.name: Dada
metas.description: A couple in love, accidentally become teenage parents. Unpleasant situations make them fall apart. Manikandan, left alone with his son, struggles as a single teenage father. Fate owns him, bringing Sindhu back into his life.

metas.name: Trainspotting
metas.description: Renton, deeply immersed in the Edinburgh drug scene, tries to clean up and get out despite the allure of drugs and the influence of friends.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

metas.name: Natsamrat
metas.description: The film is the story of an actor who has reached many heights in his career but has to retire from acting at the peak.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: The Social Network
metas.description: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea and by the co-founder who was later squeezed out of the business.

metas.name: Article 370
metas.description: Ahead of a major constitutional decision, special agent Zooni Haksar is tasked with a secret mission to quell violence in a conflict-ridden region.

metas.name: Ab Tak Chhappan
metas.description: Sadhu, an encounter specialist, is armed with a personal vendetta to find and kill the gangsters responsible for his wife's death.

metas.name: Superboys of Malegaon
metas.description: The residents of Malegaon look to Bollywood cinema for a much-needed escape from daily drudgery. Amateur filmmaker Nasir Shaikh gets inspired to make a film for the people of Malegaon, by the people of Malegaon. He bands together his ragtag group of friends to bring his vision to life, thereby bringing a fresh lease of life into the town.

metas.name: Vicky Donor
metas.description: A man is brought in by an infertility doctor to supply him with his sperm, where he becomes the biggest sperm donor for his clinic.

metas.name: The Promised Land
metas.description: The story of Danish soldier and explorer Ludvig Kahlen, who explored and cultivated Denmark's wild Jutland, which now comprises the vast majority of the country, in the mid-18th century.

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: A group of young misfits called The Goonies discover an ancient map and set out on an adventure to find a legendary pirate's long-lost treasure.

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

metas.name: Minority Report
metas.description: John works with the PreCrime police which stop crimes before they take place, with the help of three 'PreCogs' who can foresee crimes. Events ensue when John finds himself framed for a future murder.

metas.name: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
metas.description: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy is set in the 2nd World War torn Calcutta during the 1940s. Enter a magical world of nostalgia and 'Expect the Unexpected'.

metas.name: Gone Baby Gone
metas.description: Two Boston area detectives investigate a little girl's kidnapping, which ultimately turns into a crisis both professionally and personally.

metas.name: Neram
metas.description: Can a young man escape from the clutches of a loan shark on time?

metas.name: Jolly LLB
metas.description: Wanting to earn fame and fortune, a small time lawyer files a PIL for an infamous hit-and-run, and thus learns what it really is like to be a lawyer.

metas.name: Stree
metas.description: In the small town of Chanderi, the menfolk live in fear of an evil spirit named "Stree" who abducts men in the night. Based on the urban legend of "Nale Ba" that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s.

metas.name: O Kadhal Kanmani
metas.description: Two young lovers are compatible in every way - they even agree that marriage is futile. However, their emotions are not so easily managed, especially when they witness the unconditional love of the older couple with whom they live.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Sleepy Hollow
metas.description: Ichabod Crane is sent to Sleepy Hollow to investigate the decapitations of three people; the culprit is legendary apparition The Headless Horseman.

metas.name: Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: No Time to Die
metas.description: James Bond has left active service. His peace is short-lived when Felix Leiter, an old friend from the CIA, turns up asking for help, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

metas.name: Official Secrets
metas.description: The true story of a British whistleblower who leaked information to the press about an illegal NSA spy operation designed to push the UN Security Council into sanctioning the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

metas.name: Dogma
metas.description: An abortion clinic worker with a special heritage is called upon to save the existence of humanity from being negated by two renegade angels trying to exploit a loop-hole and reenter Heaven.

metas.name: Julayi
metas.description: After helping the police foil a violent heist, a sharp minded young man must evade the criminal mastermind whose plans he has thwarted.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Batla House
metas.description: In 2008, a violent shootout with terror suspects leaves one police officer struggling to hunt down the fugitives and justify the police action.

metas.name: The Lost Boys
metas.description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.
